body.subject: Recovery of the wake lane after the 20:12 restart: no seat needs resuming, four lanes staffed over the 22 reassigned issues, and the #410 landing is staged behind the MCP core-tool closure

items.change: Both dead seats in this swarm are superseded continuations, neither needs a resume, and no live holder needed releasing. wake-lead died 2026-09-21T17:43:37Z and was superseded by wake-lead2; wake-lead2 died 2026-09-22T20:12:26Z and this seat is its resumed successor (recruit with resumeFrom at seq 73142). wake-lead's one contribution landed as f09dab80; wake-lead2's only unlanded delta is the #410 one-line removal, rebased as c69de1e0 on branch baton/ws-3cde404784be06d4713fe6d3e8da029f-410. Both workspaces read holderCount 0, so there was no holder to release; swarm.stop is not in this seat's grant (wake-lead2's typed refusal at seq 71321 stands), so the two worker_lost_on_restart attention rows remain for the root to close.

carriedForward: The acceptance base for this lane is still open: this seat's worktree is a snapshot of the served commit 1e050e42, whose full suite carries the same red closure, so the canonical command cannot pass there until the MCP lane's fix lands. The predecessor's proven-green tree (master 91ad17f5 plus the lane delta, 6542 passed / 451 expected red / 0 unexpected twice) remains the only tree where the canonical command is green; when the closure clears this seat re-bases on the landed master and runs the canonical command there.

docs/54 section 3.3's per-event delivery marking (a swarm.wake_composed row per delivered event) remains unimplemented: both the brief block and the stream use the reference-seq window, as section 3.3 permits for the initial landing.
#320's pinned row is the only thing holding the followSwarm poll loop in the tree; landing #320 removes the last dead half of #410 alongside the staged removal.

Of the 22 reassigned issues, four lanes are staffed; the design-level set (#274, #181, #188, #56, #258, #228, #128, #216, #208, #106, #71, #65, #55, #50, #445, #175, #164, #249, #255, #108, #320, #410) is otherwise unstarted by this seat and will be staffed or triaged in the next round as lanes report.
needsFromOthers: mcp-lead3 (swarm-mcp-20260921) must land the core-table/alias fix on master: master is red in the core-tool closure and every wide-gate landing in the deployment waits on it. The 27-to-5 measurement and the five remaining rows were sent directly (seqs 73953 and 76246).

From the root: stop authority (or the stop itself) for wake-lead and wake-lead2, whose worker_lost_on_restart attention rows cannot be closed by this seat (no stop grant; the predecessor's refusal at seq 71321).
